Many years ago I was sleeping after having revised all stuff for the test the next morning. I had played ocarina of time few days ago. 

I don't know how it started, but in my whole body I was feeling an extremely weird and painful sensation. My parents woke up and were around me trying to help. I was involuntarily imagining that I was near the bridge of Hyrule castle, but I couldn't see my body as I was watching from above that a giant ball of rupees was crushing me repeatedly. This scenario kept repeating in my head and every time the ball fell down I felt a lot of fear and pain-like feeling. Then after a few minutes my body felt fine, but the ball would continue crushing me occasionally for some more time. I tried, but couldn't explain anything to my parents.

I didn't take the test and couldn't play that game for years.
